events.evidence: Seven people in Kyiv, Ukraine, and three more in Rostov-on-Don, Russia, are killed as both countries launch airstrikes at each other
Afghanistan says nine children and a woman were killed when a civilian home was hit by a Pakistani airstrike in Khost, Afghanistan
The World Food Programme reports that escalating instability in northern Nigeria is increasing acute food insecurity to record levels

label.note: Reciprocal Russia-Ukraine strikes and Afghanistan-Pakistan civilian casualties raise geopolitical risk.
